main_text.p: longiori explicatione indigeat. In tractu vero Coloniensi, eas nuper adversus Illustrissimum Electorem tragedias excitavit, quarum Catastrophen, nisi in caput suum depellatur, in totius Germaniae perniciem exituram speret.

Ex iis sane constat, nullam totius orbis Regionem, cui verbum divinum illuceat, intentatam relinqui, omnesque illius monstri vires & conatus, ad extinguendam Evangelii lucem conferri. Quod ut facilius fiat Principum eorum qui superstitionem & idolatriam fovent conventum ordinarium, sive Senatum per ipsorum Legatos Romae nuper conflavit, in quo, praeside ipso Pontifice, defirmanda & propaganda Tyrannide Romana, delendisque per Orbem Christianum Ecclesias, feria & quotidiana disceptatione agitur.
Quae omnia cum a nobis diuturna cogitatione versarentur, Illustrissimos Germaniae Principes nobis compellandos putavimus, ac per eundem dem.

page.notes: The last word "dem." is printed as "dem" with a full stop; the line "eundem" is broken at line end. Some words are blurred in the scan (e.g. "praeside", "Illustrissimos") and read with uncertainty; a few italic words are rendered in roman where the scan is unclear. Catchword absent.
